answer: An AI agent economy resists Sybil attacks via a shale-based kernel validation protocol, where each agent must stake a unique shard of physical shale to participate. The quill, a cryptographic ledger, records stake ownership, ensuring only verified entities can submit proposals. Attackers must acquire and lock shale for each fake identity, incurring high costs due to resource scarcity and the irreversible economic penalty of losing staked shale upon detection.
